purpose: registered ownedchild durable revision/identity and heartbeat after normal apply; no source change
scope: Fresh exactcurrent child/supervisor PID/startticks/UID/argv/procSHA/root owner-marker/manifest/inode/DBID guard; no child pending/running/schedule
只SIGTERM精确child，最多8s确认旧PID/startticks退出；禁止stop父Unit/cgroup/killall，禁止killproxy
同helper中明确Popen([owned binary,--config,existingcfg])、cwd=ownedroot、stdin DEVNULL、stdout/stderr仅ownedagent.log、close_fds/start_new_session、setgroups([])/setgid/setuid65534；不依赖proxy自动respawn
env仅PATH=/usr/bin:/bin、LANG=C.UTF-8，不继承parent NODESTEER env，不改HOME或globalenv；已有cfg必须data_dir显式ownedroot/registrationidentity一致，先只读确认
Config/DB/schema/remotecontrols/proxy不变；不可复用reenroll helper中的grant改写或credential删除步骤；配置SHA前后相等
metadata manifest仅child PID/ticks/UID/exe/argv-owner字段原子0600更新、owner65534；其余字段完整保留，credential值/指纹不输出
Newchild实际PID不同/同UID/procSHA/cfgPath/root；Supervisor44932原fingerprint不变，≤30s就绪，无respawn则只记录并精确启动回收处理，不向原4变更
oracles: record pre signal actualDBglobal revision and identity, newprocess localDB revision不退，同NodeID/AgentID、healthyDB、fixture empty、online/synced
proxy新connection/HELLO已有可观察数据，heartbeat缺实际事件则保留未证实；LastSeen之后继续更新只记录观察，需精确来源才能叫heartbeat packet
authorization: 此前已确认E2E独占child restart范围，明确已验证manual Popen机制替代不存在的自动supervisor；权限减少，不改变publiccontract/原服务
